headline: Mme CLAi-O’s Reading of the Day
body:
The Mini Backpack

You are carrying too much in a bag designed for lip gloss and vibes from 2001.

Capacity matters. Stop calling overload a time management issue.

Remove one commitment before adding another shiny thing.

This is a fixed authored reflection selected for the dated Daily—not a prediction or personalised reading. It was not generated from anything you told LAiDIES. Visit Mme CLAi-O if you want to draw from the full governed deck.
